church.name: Calder Hill Chapel
church.parking: Park free on Calder Lane or in the lot behind the parish hall. A greeter at the side door will point you to coffee and the sanctuary.
church.pastors: Samuel and Ruth have led Calder Hill since 2014. Samuel preaches most Sundays, and Ruth leads our care and prayer ministries. You will find them by the side door after either service, and they would much rather hear your story than tell their own.
church.kids: Calder Kids runs during the 11:00 service, with a nursery for babies and toddlers and classes through fifth grade. Check in at the welcome table and a teacher will walk you over. Little ones are always welcome in the pews at 9:00 too.
church.students: Youth group meets Wednesday nights in the parish hall, right after the church supper, for sixth through twelfth grade. Young adults gather twice a month for dinner and Bible study.
church.groups: About twenty small groups meet in homes across Richmond during the week. We call them tables, because most of them start with a meal. There is also a Tuesday Bible study at the chapel. It is the surest way to go from visitor to friend.
church.startHere: Welcome. Come on any Sunday, park on Calder Lane and follow the brick path to the side door. A greeter will meet you there and point you to the coffee. When you are ready, join the pastors for lunch on the first Sunday of the month to hear our story and find your place.
church.give: You can give online in about a minute, once or every month, or place a gift in the plate on Sunday. This season we are also restoring the bell tower, and we hope to ring it again by Easter.
church.watch: Every Sunday message is online by Monday. The latest is Lift up your eyes, from Psalm 121, with Pastor Ruth. It is week four of our fall series, Songs for the Road.
church.prayer: We would be honored to pray with you. Tell us what is heavy this week, and Pastor Ruth and our prayer team will pray for you by name. If you are in crisis, call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
church.values: Deep roots, open doors. We hold to the historic Christian faith, we love our neighbors in Richmond, and we keep the door open for whoever comes next. Every Sunday since 1891, someone has held it.

newhere.t: Welcome. Come on any Sunday, park on Calder Lane and follow the brick path to the side door. Plan your visit and a greeter will be there to meet you and point you to the coffee. When you are ready, join the pastors for lunch on the first Sunday of the month to hear our story and find your place.

baptism.t: We baptize in the river each June, and our next river baptism is Sunday, June 6, 2027. If you have been wondering about it, Pastor Samuel and Pastor Ruth would be glad to talk it through with you.

curious.t: Of course. Our door has been open to believers, doubters and the simply curious since 1891. Nobody will single you out. Sit wherever you like, and if you have questions, Pastor Samuel and Pastor Ruth would be glad to listen.

access.t: Yes. The side door off the brick path has a ramp, and there is room for wheelchairs at the front and back of the sanctuary. The parish hall and the restrooms are on the same floor. Accessible parking is in the lot behind the parish hall, and a greeter will gladly help.

language.t: Our services are in English. If another language would help you or your family, call us at (804) 555-0142 and we will help however we can.

communion.t: We celebrate communion every Sunday at both services. All who follow Jesus are welcome at the rail, and you are always welcome to stay in your pew.

wear.t: Wear whatever is comfortable. You will see jeans in the pews at 9:00 and a few jackets at 11:00, and nobody minds either way.

price.t: Genesis Ministry has three plans: Care at $149 a month, Shepherd at $299 a month and Plus at $499 a month. Enterprise, for more than one campus, is scoped on a call. Customization beyond the template is available for an additional cost.

package.t: Genesis Ministry has three plans: Care at $149 a month, Shepherd at $299 a month and Plus at $499 a month. Care is the website in one of four looks (this one is Classic and Timeless), the brand board, the social marketing plan, Hope on the website (an assistant like me, answering from facts the church approves), Plan a Visit and prayer forms by email, and newsletter sign-up. Shepherd is everything in Care, plus Today, the guest pipeline, the member app, the care inbox and drafts that wait for approval, with up to 8 staff seats. Plus is everything in Shepherd, plus person pages, the Access Record screen, the spiritual gifts picture, reports, custom roles and named gift viewers, with up to 15 staff seats. Enterprise, for more than one campus, is scoped on a call.
